title: Insider Risk Program: Workload, Cycle Time, Detection Performance

list.name: detection_rule
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT detection_rule FROM case_meta ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Median handoff duration by stage (minutes)
panels.description: One bar per handoff in the 6-stage case lifecycle; the design-target annotation at 50% marks the seeded bottleneck handoff's expected share of median total cycle time (measured: 47.9%, see docs/benchmark_output.txt).

targets.rawSql: SELECT handoff_label, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY minutes) AS median_minutes FROM case_handoffs GROUP BY handoff_label ORDER BY median_minutes DESC

panels.title: Per-rule substantiation rate
panels.description: fired, substantiated and substantiation_rate per detection rule, from ir_detection.per_rule_performance.

targets.rawSql: SELECT detection_rule, COUNT(*) AS fired, SUM(CASE WHEN substantiated THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS substantiated FROM case_meta GROUP BY detection_rule ORDER BY detection_rule

panels.title: Workload by analyst and week (suppressed under 5 cases)
panels.description: A cell showing 0 means either genuinely zero cases or a cell the reporting layer suppressed for covering fewer than SUPPRESSION_THRESHOLD (5) cases; this dashboard never distinguishes the two, by design (see ir_reporting.aggregate_count).

targets.rawSql: SELECT analyst, date_trunc('week', referral_date) AS week, COUNT(*) AS n FROM case_meta GROUP BY analyst, week HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

panels.title: Open cases by stage (current backlog)
panels.description: Count of cases currently sitting at each stage; a program lever, not a resume claim this repo measures.

targets.rawSql: SELECT current_stage, COUNT(*) AS n FROM case_status GROUP BY current_stage
